g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Each single outline follows its own continuous contour; duplicate closure dots are omitted. Bread shoulder gaps and egg asymmetry are retained. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Bread and egg surfaces lower grey; continuous outer contours higher black. Exterior white unraised. No calibrated-height or material claim.
